violation_type.title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Provides Access to Walkway (26 TAC §747.2809(4))
violation_type.short_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Provides Access to Walkway
violation_type.typical_finding: There was no walkway between the cots during naptime. The cots were placed too close together.

finding_variants.text: There was no walkway between the cots during naptime. The cots were placed too close together.

The mats were arranged to where there was no space between to walk without stepping on other mats.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when mats were rearranged and there was enough space between the mats for children and caregivers to not step on top of the mats.
Children napping were placed on mats with insufficient space between each child or other furnishings.
